description.summary: Simple 4-ingredient slow cooker salsa verde chicken — dump-and-go, shreds easily, great for tacos, bowls, and meal prep.

ingredients.ingredient: beer (use gluten-free beer or chicken broth for gluten-free)
jalapeño, stem removed and diced (optional; leave seeds in for extra heat)

preparation.step: Add chicken to the slow cooker. Top with salsa verde and beer, sprinkle with cumin, and season with generous pinches of salt and a pinch of pepper. Turn chicken so both sides are coated. Cover. Cook 3-4 hours on high or 7-8 hours on low.

Chicken is ready when it shreds easily with a fork. Shred in the slow cooker and toss with the juices. Remove with a slotted spoon and serve warm. Or store shredded chicken sealed in the fridge up to 5 days or freezer up to 3 months.
Note: For gluten-free, use gluten-free beer or replace beer with chicken broth.
